name: oh-my-cpa-repo-key-for-agents
description: Machine-readable summary of docs/guides/repo-key-for-agents.md: how a coding agent obtains and uses a repository-owned Oh My CPA key.

environment.OMC_HOME: where private keys, envelopes and state live; default ~/.omc; keep outside repositories
environment.OMCPA_SERVER_URL: console URL including base path; e.g. https://omc.madebynight.top/omc
environment.OMCPA_CPA_MANAGEMENT_KEY: the CPA management key; never echo, never commit
environment.OMCPA_AGENT_NAME: self-reported agent identity shown on the approval page
environment.OMCPA_DEVICE_NAME: self-reported device identity shown on the approval page

install.success: sha256sum prints OK and `oh-my-cpa key --help` lists accept, exec, gen, install, purge, status
install.notes: this is the CLI build for key users; it does not embed the console SPA, which is served by the OMC deployment

tools.name: repo_key_query
tools.notes: state is active|none|stopped; next_kind is reuse|issue|reissue

tools.name: repo_key_apply

arguments.public_key: x25519:<base64>; required on the first application, later applications may omit it

tools.notes: status is pending on first application, approved when a previously approved caller reuses the same key; the caller identity comes from X-Omc-Agent and X-Omc-Device, not from arguments; approval link lifetime is 24 hours

tools.name: repo_key_ciphertext
tools.notes: ciphertext is an X25519-HKDF-SHA256-AES256-GCM envelope; it opens only with the registered private key; fetching before approval returns status=error, code=operation_failed

status.success: exit 0; prints local keys, envelope presence, approval state, installed runtimes
status.notes: --remote needs OMCPA_SERVER_URL and a credential; it only reads repo_key_status and repo_key_query

gen.success: stdout is exactly one line: x25519:<base64>; stderr names the private key file
gen.notes: an existing key is reused; a key is never replaced silently

accept.stdin: the repo_key_ciphertext result: the capability envelope, the bare data object, or a bare envelope
accept.success: exit 0; prints accepted <repo>: key <mask> at <envelope file> (or replaced the envelope ...)
accept.notes: validates the envelope against the local private key before storing

exec.success: the child runs; its exit code becomes key exec's exit code once started
exec.notes: opens the envelope in memory only; codex requires the command to be codex itself; opencode reads GET <base-url>/v1/models unless --models is given

install.success: exit 0; writes the runtime's user-level configuration after backing the previous file up
install.notes: the only command that leaves the plaintext on disk; never point it at a project-level configuration

purge.success: exit 0; private key, envelope, installed values and local record removed; a following key exec fails with key_not_found (exit 4)
purge.notes: local only; the key in CPA stays active until the operator stops or reissues it in the console

flow: key status (optional) to see what the machine already holds
key gen --repo <org>/<repo> --base-url https://api.concertcalendar.cloud; take x25519:<base64> from stdout
repo_key_apply {repo, purpose, public_key}; record application_id; give approval_url to a human
poll repo_key_status (or key status --remote) until approved; never fetch ciphertext before approval
key exec --runtime <runtime> --repo <repo> -- <command> (or key install when it must persist)
key purge --repo <repo> when done; a following key exec fails with key_not_found

exit_codes.0: success, including already existed / reused / already gone
exit_codes.1: operation failed (I/O, decrypt, backup, gateway or remote refusal, an item left behind)
exit_codes.2: usage error (unknown subcommand, missing --runtime, a command Codex will not accept)
exit_codes.4: a key, envelope, application or installed value was not found
exit_codes.5: conflict: a different key or value already occupies the place, or state is corrupt
exit_codes.note: key exec returns the child's exit code once the child has started

error_codes.detail: The agent name is required and must be at most 128 characters.
error_codes.fix: set X-Omc-Agent (or OMCPA_AGENT_NAME) and reconnect the MCP session

error_codes.detail: The device name could not be determined; reconnect with a device header.
error_codes.fix: set X-Omc-Device (or OMCPA_DEVICE_NAME) and reconnect the MCP session
the credential is read-only or lacks the tool; apply with the management key or have the operator file the application in the console
the arguments do not match the tool schema (for example an extra agent field); use only the documented arguments
read the detail; a required field is missing or too long
supply a valid Authorization: Bearer credential
the application is not approved yet; the server does not expose the pending reason; wait for the decision
apply again for a fresh application and link, or ask the operator to re-issue the link in the console
fix $OMC_HOME path and ownership
let key create OMC_HOME under the user's home, or remove inherited permissions
pass --repo org/repo or run from the repository root
use org/repo or a local directory name; absolute paths and .. are refused
run key gen; after a purge this is the expected counterproof
the private key file is not readable or is not 32 bytes; purge before generating a new one
a key file appeared during generation; rerun key gen to reuse it
fetch repo_key_ciphertext and pipe it into key accept
pass the tool result as it came back
the envelope is sealed to another key pair; check OMC_HOME and the repository
set --base-url or OMCPA_CPA_BASE_URL (key gen --base-url records it in config.json); key gen itself does not require a gateway address
the URL is not http/https, has userinfo, a query or a fragment, or names a concrete endpoint such as /v1/messages or /v1/responses; a trailing / and one trailing /v1 are trimmed and accepted
warning only, printed by key exec and key install (key gen records the address without warning) when the gateway is a non-loopback http:// URL; confirm that is acceptable
use claude, codex or opencode
put the command after --
call codex directly instead of a wrapper, or use key install
the envelope and private key disagree; fetch again, or purge and generate a new key (needs a new approval)
fix permissions on $OMC_HOME/state.json; exec works by deterministic paths even if state is lost
state.json is corrupt; do not delete .lock while a command runs
another key write holds the lock; wait and rerun
fix permissions on the runtime configuration
the runtime configuration is JSONC or otherwise not pure JSON; nothing was rewritten
the merged OpenCode configuration exceeds 24 KiB; use key install
resolve the foreign value by hand or pass --replace where supported
purge the other repository's install or pass --replace
pass --models id1,id2 for OpenCode; nothing was written or started
the gateway's /v1/models could not be read with this key; fix the gateway address or network, or pass --models
the backup could not be written, so the target file was not touched
the runtime configuration was not written; read the message
that runtime has no installed value for this repository
the configured value no longer matches this repository's key; it was left alone
set OMCPA_SERVER_URL and the credential for status --remote
OMC could not be reached; local state is unchanged
something belonging to this repository could not be removed; it is listed, rerun after fixing
the child could not be started (missing program, permission, working directory)
correct the command line

prohibitions: never print, echo or log the plaintext key, the private key file, or the decrypted envelope
never put the key, the envelope or OMC_HOME in git or in any repository worktree
never write $OMC_HOME/envelopes yourself; only key accept stores an envelope
never put the key in a command line, a tool argument, or a project-level runtime configuration
never approve an application or open the approval_url on the human's behalf
never treat key purge as revocation; the key in CPA stays active
never fetch repo_key_ciphertext before the application is approved
system_prompt_short: You have an Oh My CPA repository key. Work only through `oh-my-cpa key`: set OMC_HOME=~/.omc, OMCPA_CPA_BASE_URL=https://api.concertcalendar.cloud, OMCPA_SERVER_URL=https://omc.madebynight.top/omc, OMCPA_AGENT_NAME and OMCPA_DEVICE_NAME. Run `oh-my-cpa key gen --repo <org>/<repo>` and send its stdout public key to `repo_key_apply` over OMC MCP (headers Authorization, X-Omc-Agent, X-Omc-Device). Give approval_url to the human; never approve it yourself; poll repo_key_status. Fetch repo_key_ciphertext and pipe it into `oh-my-cpa key accept --repo <org>/<repo> --application-id <id>`. Run `oh-my-cpa key exec --runtime claude|codex|opencode --repo <org>/<repo> -- <cmd>`. Never print, commit or log the key, private key or envelope; never put the key in a command line or project config. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage, 3 config, 4 not found, 5 conflict.
